documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text: Gmusic Academy refunds unused course months within 14 days of purchase. Partial months are not prorated after the first lesson is completed.

documents.title: Billing and cancellation
documents.text: Cancel a subscription from Cuenta > Facturacion. Access continues until the paid period ends. No charges after a confirmed cancellation receipt.

documents.title: How to tune a guitar
documents.text: Standard tuning is E A D G B E. Use a clip tuner or a reference pitch, then tune each string from low E to high E and recheck the low E.

documents.title: Major scale primer
documents.text: The major scale pattern is W W H W W W H. Practice one octave slowly before linking positions.
